hero.title: Stock, orders and sales forecasts in one place.
hero.lead: WMS keeps your inventory in sync with every order, warns you days before a product runs out, and forecasts next month's sales from your own numbers.
hero.fine: Runs in the browser · Greek and English

features.title: Everything a small warehouse needs, nothing it doesn't.
features.sub: Built around the questions you ask every day: what do I have, what's running out, and what will I sell next month.

inventory.title: Inventory that updates itself
inventory.body: Complete a purchase or sale order and stock moves on its own. Every change is kept in a movement log, so you always know why a number changed.

reorder.title: Reorder alerts before you run out
reorder.body: Based on the last 30 days of outgoing stock, WMS estimates how many days each product has left and flags the ones that need ordering now.

forecast.title: Sales forecast from your own data
forecast.body: Upload a CSV with your daily sales and get a 7 to 90-day forecast, with optional factors like promotions, temperature and marketing spend.

customers.title: Know which customers matter
customers.body: Customers are grouped automatically into high value, loyal, new and at risk, based on how recently, how often and how much they buy.

orders.title: Purchase & sale orders
orders.body: Draft, confirm, complete or cancel, with line items and prices.

datasets.title: Edit data in the browser
datasets.body: Upload CSV files, preview them and fix rows without Excel.

language.title: Greek & English
language.body: Switch language or light/dark theme at any time.

access.title: Your data stays yours
access.body: Each business is visible only to its own members.

how.title: Up and running in an afternoon.

products.title: Add your products
products.body: SKU, name, prices and the stock level at which you want to reorder.

orders.title: Record orders as they happen
orders.body: Purchases bring stock in, sales take it out. Completing an order updates inventory.

insights.title: Act on alerts and forecasts
insights.body: See what to reorder this week and what demand to expect next month.

who.title: Made for businesses that keep stock.

retail.title: Retail shops
retail.body: Hardware, pharmacy, cosmetics or pet shops with hundreds of SKUs on the shelf.

wholesale.title: Wholesalers & distributors
wholesale.body: Supply many customers and need to see who buys what, and when.

eshop.title: E-shops
eshop.body: Keep stock accurate across orders and plan purchases ahead of peaks.

food.title: Cafés, bakeries & kitchens
food.body: Track consumables and raw materials so you never run short mid-week.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. WMS runs in the browser on any computer, tablet or phone. Sign up and start adding products.
Yes. The whole app works in Greek and English and you can switch at any time.

items.q: What do I need for the sales forecast?
items.a: A CSV file with a date column and a sales column, one row per day, covering at least the last two months. Temperature, promotions and marketing spend are optional and improve the forecast.
Only the members of your business. Sessions are kept in secure cookies, and you can reset your password by email if you forget it.

closing.title: Start with your top 20 products today.
closing.body: Add them, record this week's orders, and by Friday you'll know what to reorder.

steps.shopify: In Shopify, the webhook “Order payment” should point to the URL above. Each paid order reduces your stock here.
